project.description: The name of the feature library project to initialize.

projects.description: The list of feature library projects to initialize.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing files during initialization.

skipProjects.description: Whether to skip executing project-specific initialization logic.

skipFormat.description: Whether to skip formatting files with Prettier after initialization.

routes.description: Whether the feature library should expose Angular routes.

targets.description: Target configuration options for the feature library.

fixDependencies.description: Whether to add the 'fix-dependencies' target to the project.

indexExport.description: Whether to add the 'index-export' target to the project.
